![](/images/google_icon.png)
![NVIDIA logo with Technology background](https://www.marketbeat.com/logos/nvidia-co-logo-1200x675.jpg?v=20221020142916)

## Key Points

Shares of NVIDIA Corporation ([NASDAQ:NVDA](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NVDA/) - [Get Free Report](https://www.marketbeat.com/arnreports/ReportTickerOptin.aspx?RegistrationCode=TickerHyperlink&Prefix=NASDAQ&Symbol=NVDA)) shot up 2.1% on Monday. The company traded as high as $240.10 and last traded at $238.90. Approximately 124,090,358 shares changed hands during mid-day trading, a decline of 19% from the average daily volume of 153,683,313 shares. The stock had previously closed at $233.95.

Citigroup restated a "buy" rating and set a $315.00 price target (up from $300.00) on shares of NVIDIA in a report on Thursday, August 27th. Mizuho set a $315.00 target price on NVIDIA and gave the company an "outperform" rating in a research report on Thursday, August 27th. Benchmark restated a "buy" rating and set a $335.00 price objective on shares of NVIDIA in a report on Thursday, August 27th. Finally, China Renaissance increased their target price on NVIDIA from $319.00 to $330.00 and gave the stock a "buy" rating in a research note on Monday, August 31st. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14, a quick ratio of 3.85 and a current ratio of 4.59. NVIDIA ([NASDAQ:NVDA](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NVDA/) - [Get Free Report](https://www.marketbeat.com/arnreports/ReportTickerOptin.aspx?RegistrationCode=TickerHyperlink&Prefix=NASDAQ&Symbol=NVDA)) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Wednesday, August 26th. The computer hardware maker reported $2.22 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts' consensus estimates of $2.09 by $0.13. NVIDIA had a return on equity of 96.04% and a net margin of 63.66%.The company had revenue of $96.22 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $92.27 billion. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $1.05 earnings per share. The firm's revenue for the quarter was up 105.9% compared to the same quarter last year. Sell-side analysts forecast that NVIDIA Corporation will post 9.25 EPS for the current fiscal year.

## NVIDIA Announces Dividend

The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, October 1st. Stockholders of record on Thursday, September 10th were issued a dividend of $0.25 per share. The ex-dividend date was Thursday, September 10th. This represents a $1.00 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 0.4%. NVIDIA's dividend payout ratio is 12.64%.

NVIDIA declared that its Board of Directors has approved a stock buyback plan on Monday, September 28th that authorizes the company to repurchase $150.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization authorizes the computer hardware maker to repurchase up to 2.8% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares repurchase plans are often a sign that the company's leadership believes its stock is undervalued.

## Insiders Place Their Bets

In other NVIDIA news, EVP [Timothy Teter](https://www.insidertrades.com/nvidia-co-stock/timothy-s-teter) sold 30,460 shares of the company's stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, September 21st. The shares were sold at an average price of $222.80, for a total transaction of $6,786,488.00. Following the transaction, the executive vice president owned 2,687,660 shares in the company, valued at approximately $598,810,648. This represents a 1.12% decrease in their position. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which can be accessed through [the SEC website](http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000169684126000014/xslF345X06/wk-form4_1790196985.xml). The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Also, CFO [Colette Kress](https://www.insidertrades.com/nvidia-co-stock/colette-kress) sold 34,918 shares of the firm's stock in a transaction on Thursday, September 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $219.05, for a total transaction of $7,648,787.90. Following the completion of the transaction, the chief financial officer directly owned 765,103 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $167,595,812.15. This represents a 4.36% decrease in their position. Additional details regarding this sale are available in the [official SEC disclosure](http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000158867026000014/xslF345X06/wk-form4_1789765959.xml). The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. In the last quarter, insiders have sold 1,766,118 shares of company stock valued at $399,450,353. Insiders own 3.94% of the company's stock.

## About NVIDIA

([Get Free Report](https://www.marketbeat.com/arnreports/ReportTickerOptin.aspx?RegistrationCode=TickerHyperlink&Prefix=NASDAQ&Symbol=NVDA))

NVIDIA Corporation is a technology company that designs accelerated computing platforms, graphics processing units (GPUs), central processing units (CPUs), networking products and related software. Its technologies are used in artificial intelligence, data centers, scientific and technical computing, gaming, professional visualization, automotive systems and robotics.

The company's products include GeForce GPUs and gaming software, data center computing platforms, networking solutions, and enterprise software for AI development and deployment.

# Nvidia Stock Climbs as AI Finds New Growth Path in Healthcare

![](https://s3-symbol-logo.tradingview.com/nvidia.svg)

Nvidia [![](https://s3-symbol-logo.tradingview.com/nvidia.svg)NVDA](/symbols/NASDAQ-NVDA/) gained about 1% in morning trading Monday as the chipmaker pointed to growing medical applications for its computing platform, including tools being developed for breast cancer care, according to a Monday company blog post.

![](https://s3-symbol-logo.tradingview.com/nvidia.svg)

The broader opportunity comes from a healthcare system handling more diagnostic images while specialist capacity remains limited. Nvidia's Inception initiative is designed to help startups build around its technology by providing access to technical expertise and business resources.

Among the companies involved, iSono Health is working on an AI-assisted wearable ultrasound device. Its system produces three-dimensional breast scans and is designed to collect data much faster than conventional handheld examinations.

Ataraxis AI is applying Nvidia technology further along the treatment process. The startup develops models intended to help physicians prepare cancer treatment plans using clinical information.

The activity gives Nvidia another channel for expanding demand beyond traditional data-center customers.

# Nvidia stock hits record as Foxconn posts 47% revenue surge

Foxconn reported third-quarter revenue of 3.03 trillion New Taiwan dollars, up 47% from a year earlier, driven by AI server demand

[By Cris Tolomia](/author/cristolomia)·2 min read·Updated October 6, 2026

[Add QZ to Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=qz.com)

Chris Morris

Nvidia[$NVDA](/quote/NVDA) stock climbed to a record high on Monday after its Taiwanese manufacturing partner Foxconn [reported a surge in AI-driven revenue](https://www.barrons.com/articles/nvidia-stock-price-record-foxconn-e1dcee95), signaling continued momentum in demand for AI hardware.

Nvidiastock rose 2.1% to $238.90 on Monday, surpassing its previous all-time closing high of $235.74, reached in May. The company's market capitalization stands at $5.6 trillion.

Foxconn, formally known as Hon Hai Precision Industry, reported September-quarter revenue of 3.03 trillion New Taiwan dollars ($95.48 billion), up 47% from the same period a year earlier. Foxconn indicated that its artificial-intelligence business would continue to expand through the end of the year, stopping short of offering a precise forecast.

Foxconn's profile in the U.S. centers on its role assembling Apple[$AAPL](/quote/AAPL) devices, but the bulk of its business comes from cloud and networking infrastructure — notably AI servers built around Nvidia chips, according to Barron's.

Nvidia's record close comes at a moment when the stock has been trading at a historically low valuation relative to its earnings growth. Nvidiastock had been [trading near its lowest forward earnings multiple in more than a decade](https://qz.com/nvidia-stock-valuation-decade-low-earnings-092226), even as revenue and net income were each projected to grow by roughly 90% or more in its current fiscal year. At Monday's close, Nvidia trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 17.1 times, according to Barron's, citing FactSet.

The stock's subdued valuation had drawn attention from NvidiaChief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, who called the company "the world's first and only growth value stock" and described Nvidiaas "incredibly misunderstood" at a Goldman Sachs[$GS](/quote/GS) technology conference last month.

Separately, Nvidia[authorized a $150 billion increase to its share repurchase program](https://qz.com/nvidia-share-buyback-repurchase-record-150-billion-092826) last week, bringing the total remaining buyback authorization to $235 billion — the largest such authorization increase in history, the company said. The company expects to complete the total remaining program through fiscal year 2028.

Analysts covering Nvidiahave set a consensus price target of $334.45 on the shares, according to Barron's, citing FactSet.

# Nvidia stock rises to new highs as market cap closes in on $6 trillion

[![Daniel Howley](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/a12b6af8cf689b02726e54920c175340a6840f9d02c463910e39eb7067d3738a/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w80_h80%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fd29szjachogqwa.cloudfront.net%2Fimages%2Fuser-uploaded%2F1754943068701_4936.jpeg)](/author/daniel-howley)

[Daniel Howley](/author/daniel-howley)  · Technology Editor

* [NVDA

  +1.08%](/quote/NVDA/ "NVDA")

Nvidia ([NVDA](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/)) stock hit a new all-time intraday high on Tuesday after closing at an all-time high on Monday.

The stock opened trading at $242/share, with the company's intraday market cap hit $5.84 trillion, moving closer to the $6 trillion mark.

[Nvidia is riding high](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-was-everywhere-in-q3-the-ai-giants-stock-proves-it-152047325.html) on continued spending on AI infrastructure amid the broader global build-out. The company, which designs graphics processing units (GPUs) and their associated networking and other systems, is the poster child for the AI hardware race.

### ([NVDA](/quote/NVDA/) )

[Go deeper with AlphaSpace](https://finance.yahoo.com/plus/alphaspace/?.done=https%3A%2F%2Falphaspace.finance.yahoo.com%2F%3Fview%3Danalysis%26ticker%3DNVDA&ncid=100003562)

241.49  +2.59  (+1.08%)

As of 11:31:10 AM EDT. Market Open.

In its August Q2 earnings report, Nvidia topped Wall Street's already lofty expectations on both the top and bottom lines, reporting revenue of $96.2 billion and offering a better-than-anticipated outlook for its third quarter. The company said it expects sales of between $105.8 billion and $110.1 billion.

CEO Jensen Huang is one of the [AI industry's most prominent leaders,](https://finance.yahoo.com/video/breaking-down-jensen-huangs-biggest-141014414.html) frequently appearing [alongside President Trump](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/trump-gathers-with-ai-leaders-floats-self-regulation-as-the-way-to-deal-with-the-technologys-dangers-193745293.html) at AI- and tech-focused events and traveling the world to meet with foreign leaders.

[![NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang listens as President Donald Trump speaks to reporters at the White House in Washington, Tuesday Sept. 29, 2026, after meeting with top executives of AI firms. (AP Photo/Jacquelyn Martin)](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///ywAAAAAAQABAAACAUwAOw==)](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/2a347c9bf7bc7ad3623115ef130b97d74b2d0f0a20077388d7f5b5df07a46314/lightyear_networkapi/resizefit_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fd29szjachogqwa.cloudfront.net%2Fimages%2F2026-10%2Feb79c0f2-0ee0-465d-b70f-7bff1e5c58a9)

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang listens as President Donald Trump speaks to reporters at the White House in Washington, Tuesday Sept. 29, 2026, after meeting with top executives of AI firms. (AP Photo/Jacquelyn Martin) · AP Photo/Jacquelyn Martin

 

The AI trade has faced frequent ups and downs since OpenAI debuted ChatGPT in November 2022, with investors regularly questioning whether the market is in an AI bubble and, if so, when it will burst.

Nvidia and its cohort have also raised questions about so-called circular investing, deals in which it invests in its own customers, who then purchase additional chips from Nvidia.

It also faces growing competition from the likes of AMD ([AMD](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMD/)), which recently launched its own rack-scale system to compete with Nvidia, as well as from customers like Amazon ([AMZN](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/)) and Google ([GOOG](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GOOG/), [GOOGL](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GOOGL/)), which are increasingly offering up their own custom chips to third-party clients.

## What Happened?

Reflection AI, a startup backed by Nvidia ([NVDA](https://app.tikr.com/stock/about?cid=32307&tid=2635154&ref=49x9sy)), launched its [first open-weight model on Monday. It is called Beam](https://www.reuters.com/technology/nvidia-backed-reflection-unveils-first-ai-model-take-chinese-open-models-2026-10-05/).

The goal is to compete with cheaper Chinese models like DeepSeek and Kimi on coding and agentic tasks.

Reflection says Beam holds up well against Z.ai’s GLM-5.2. It also says Beam is closing in on Qwen3.8-Max.

Here is the technical part in simple terms. Beam has 501 billion total parameters. Those are the variables an AI model uses to process information. But Beam only uses 23 billion of them for each task.

That makes it faster and cheaper to run. GLM-5.2 has about 744 billion total and 40 billion active.

The timing matters. US tech firms are trying to fend off Chinese open-weight models. Those models are cheaper and easier to customize.

They can also write code almost as well as top models from OpenAI and Anthropic.

It builds tools that automate software development. Earlier this year, it signed a deal with SpaceX for extra computing power at the Colossus 2 data center.

## What the Market Is Telling Us About Nvidia Stock

This is not a direct earnings event for Nvidia. Still, Nvidia stock is tied to the AI model race. More models mean more demand for computing power.

On the latest call, Nvidia said it runs both closed and open models. CEO Jensen Huang said nearly all open models run on Nvidia. He also said open models are doing incredibly well.

The business backs that up. Q2 revenue was $96 billion, more than double last year. Data center revenue hit $89 billion.

Nvidia expects Q3 revenue of $108 billion and about 70% growth next fiscal year. It says supply is the limit, not demand.

There are risks too. Gross margin is expected to dip to 71% to 72% in Q4 as memory costs rise.

Nvidia also noted that its outlook includes no China data center revenue.

# Nvidia Stock at New All-Time Highs: Market Expert Says ‘Cusp of a Major Breakout’

**Nvidia Corp** [(NASDAQ:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NVDA)[NVDA](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NVDA)) stock recently hit new all-time highs. A market expert says more gains could be coming for the world’s [most valuable company.](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/long-ideas/26/09/61902221/nvidia-earnings-miss-unthinkable-vaneck-flags-real-risk)

**• NVIDIA stock is showing positive momentum. [What’s the outlook for NVDA shares?](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NVDA)**

## **Jay Woods on NVDA Stock**

Nvidia stock is breaking out to new highs, a move that has Freedom Capital Markets Chief Market Strategist Jay Woods taking note.

"The one chart that has me optimistic … Nvidia," Woods said in a weekly [newsletter](https://www.freedomcapmkts.com/newsletter).

After several periods of sideways action on the Nvidia stock chart, Woods is noticing patterns of good news for investors.

"Nvidia is on the cusp of a major breakout. When looking at the chart, it’s on the verge of another significant breakout and that should be good enough for now to take this market another leg higher."

Woods said the $240 level is the area to watch for Nvidia, which is only slightly higher than where shares are trading Monday. A close above $240 could take Nvidia higher on a "clear breakout." Woods sets an upside target of $270 for Nvidia stock.

"We have seen this stock lead in the past and it’s poised to lead again."

Nvidia is nearing its third-quarter report, which will be a key moment for the overall stock market ahead of the end of 2026.

Nvidia has beaten analyst estimates for earnings per share in 15 straight quarters and beaten revenue estimates in 16 straight quarters.

Woods call for a higher share price comes ahead of earnings. Hitting new all-time highs ahead of the earnings report could put more pressure on the financials and guidance from the company.

## Nvidia Gets A Major Target Boost

[Nvidia stock](https://stocktwits.com/symbol/NVDA) surged to a record high of $240.10 as BNP Paribas issued a more bullish outlook, raising its price target to $345 from $285 while maintaining an ‘Outperform’ rating. The new price target implies a 44% upside to Monday’s close.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

The firm sees Nvidia's combination of CUDA software, NVLink networking and Blackwell processors as a competitive advantage as demand shifts toward AI inference workloads. Nvidia is a major player in the AI boom, supported by record sales and profits. It is also expanding its reach by investing in AI companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI.

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around the stock jumped to ‘bullish’ from ‘bearish’ territory the previous day.

## TSMC Eyes Musk-Linked Chip Project

[Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing stock](https://stocktwits.com/symbol/TSM) also reached an all-time high of $487.47 amid[discussions](https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/tesla-stock-musk-something-may-come-of-tsmc-talks-on-terafab/cZDpjv8RBSE) involving Elon Musk's proposed Terafab semiconductor initiative. Under the potential arrangement, TSMC could develop and run a dedicated manufacturing operation for companies including Tesla, SpaceX and xAI.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Musk confirmed that discussions are taking place but cautioned that no agreement has been finalized, writing on X, “Just discussions, but something may come of it.” Retail sentiment around the stock improved to ‘extremely bullish’ from ‘bullish’ territory the previous day.

## WBD Moves Toward A New Era

[Warner Bros. Discovery stock](https://stocktwits.com/symbol/WBD) climbed to a four-year high of $30.99 as its combination with Paramount Skydance (PSKY) moved into its final operational stage. The transition marks a major change for the entertainment company following months of deal-related uncertainty.

Incoming Chairman and CEO David Ellison and co-CEO Ynon Kreiz have outlined the leadership structure for the combined business. Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein will oversee film operations, while Casey Bloys will continue leading direct-to-consumer streaming. James Gunn and Peter Safran will remain in charge of DC Studios. Retail sentiment remained ‘bullish’.

Technology stocks and U.S. long-dated Treasury yields dominated the market narrative at the start of the week.

A booming demand for artificial intelligence has bolstered a climb in tech stocks.[Nvidia Corp. (NVDA)](https://stocktwits.com/symbol/NVDA) and[Broadcom Inc. Meanwhile, U.S. long-dated Treasury yields also spiked on Monday. At the time of writing, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield was trading at 5.313%, and the 30-year Treasury bond yield was trading at 5.67%.

Morgan Stanley Wealth Management investment chief Lisa Shalett reportedly wrote in a note that bonds have faced heightened volatility over the past six weeks, according to a CNBC report.

Shalett cited the potential for a new Federal Reserve policy framework, economic growth, and elevated oil prices amid the ongoing Middle East conflict as a reason for the volatility. She said that while intraday implied volatility has increased, the recent moves have yet to reach the extreme levels that preceded the 2022 equity bear market.

Last week, “Bond King” Bill Gross noted in a Financial Times op-ed that markets must be prepared for the end of “what you are used to” in stock markets and higher volatility in prices for the benchmark 10-year Treasury bonds.

As stocks rise to record levels and yields climb simultaneously, “my view is: don’t own bonds, with the exception of one-year Treasury bills, which are now at 4.55 percent,” he said.

## Craig-Hallum Sees No Meaningful Demand Increase At Sphere

Craig-Hallum analyst Ryan Sigdahl downgraded Sphere Entertainment to 'hold' from 'buy,'according to a summary of the note on The Fly, and lowered his price target to $132 from $170, citing "faster-than-expected" weakening in demand for “The Wizard of Oz”.The new target still implies 19% upside from Monday's close.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Sigdahl said recent numbers show the updated version of the show, released Sept. 25, has not meaningfully increased demand. He also plans to cut his financial estimates, citing deteriorating demand trends.

The update added 4D effects including moving Winged Monkeys, scents, fireworks, and "Glinda Glitter." The show has been running in Las Vegas since Aug. 28, 2025.

Last month, Sphere said the attraction has generated more than $500 million in ticket sales, with more than 4 million tickets sold since its debut.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

According to multiple reports, tickets for “The Wizard of Oz” at Sphere in Las Vegas generally range from $96 to $349 depending on your seat location, package tier, and showtime.

## Higher Costs Weigh On Sphere Entertainment’s Profit

Sphere reported fiscal second-quarter revenue of $313.6 million in August, up 11% from a year earlier. Its operating loss widened to $61.3 million from $50.2 million, and adjusted operating income declined 17% to $50.9 million. The loss per share was $1.07.

Revenue from the Sphere business climbed 29% to $226.4 million. The increase was largely driven by higher revenue from “The Wizard of Oz,” which recorded 220 performances during the quarter.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Higher revenue came with increased costs. Sphere-related operating expenses rose 15%, while selling, general and administrative expenses increased 30%. Sphere Entertainment stock has been posting monthly losses since July.

## **Sequoia Partner Sees SpaceX’s Investor Awakening**

“We are seeing the very beginning of investors starting to understand SpaceX,” Sequoia Capital partner Shaun Maguire[said on X](https://x.com/shaunmmaguire/status/2107117710517911731). He was responding to Mach33 founder and CEO Aaron Burnett, who urged investors to study SpaceX while others were still catching up. Burnett’s post discussed Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas’ observation that few clients appeared to own the stock.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

In an[excerpt](https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2106894988265099708) shared by Tesla investor and influencer Sawyer Merritt, Jonas recalled asking 40 clients whether anyone owned SPCX shares. “Not a single hand went up,” he said.

Jonas argued that assessing SpaceX solely through telecommunications, aerospace and defense, or AI misses the connections between its businesses. “Valuing SPCX is more of an ‘and’ problem than an ‘or’ problem,” he said. “The unusual dimensionality that makes it challenging to value the stock, in and of itself, gives the stock its value.”

Burnett[questioned](https://x.com/aaronburnett/status/2107143814401958021) why the “loudest” voices on asset pricing often had done the “least work” to understand underlying value, while acknowledging a place for both valuation shortcuts and technical research. “SpaceX is among the most difficult technology suites in the world to ‘intuit’ and getting more complex not less,” he said. “The complexity is equally a challenge and opportunity, depends on your perspective.”

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Wells Fargo said SpaceX is redeploying engineers from its launch and connectivity divisions to orbital data center work, prioritizing AI satellites ahead of a demonstration launch targeted for the second quarter of 2027. Scaled deployment would follow once Starship supports a faster launch cadence.

Last week highlighted the breadth of its operations: SpaceX launched a NASA crew to the International Space Station, sent Google AI chips into orbit on a separate flight and deployed next-generation Starlink satellites aboard Starship.

Musk also[said](https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/spcx-stock-musk-teases-spacexsi-trump-si-push-analyst-shares-unusually-cheap/cZDpLwyRB1D) SpaceXAI would become SpaceXSI, embracing U.S. President Donald Trump’s superintelligence branding.

## **ARK Eyes Starship’s Revenue And Reusability Upside**

ARK Investment Management analysts Tasha Keeney and Daniel Maguire[said](https://x.com/ARKInvest/status/2107201650687443127) Starship is “reshaping the industry once again,” estimating that Flight 14’s 26 Starlink V3 satellites could support nearly $560 million in annualized revenue.

The estimate applies SpaceX’s reported second-quarter revenue run-rate to the added downlink capacity. A fully loaded Starship could deliver about 20 times the bandwidth of a Falcon 9 launch carrying V2 Minis, ARK said.

The bigger opportunity rests on full reusability, which ARK estimates could cut launch costs to $100 per kilogram or less at scale and make orbital data centers economically feasible. Frontier-model AI could represent more than 90% of SpaceX’s stated $28.5 trillion addressable market, the firm said.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

“A successful upper-stage catch would put full reusability—and a new era of launch economics—within reach,” ARK said.

Morgan Stanley said that a potential catch could be “the biggest positive catalyst since the IPO.” Meanwhile, Wells Fargo offered a later timeline, calling a booster catch a reasonable target but a ship catch “likely a late ’27 / early ’28 story.” Morgan Stanley’s $300 target implies about 75% upside from Monday’s close. Wells Fargo rates shares ‘overweight’ with a $212 target, implying about 24% upside.

Moderna shares rose about 7%, a move also tied to its pending addition to the Nasdaq-100, while BioNTech edged 1% higher after Vaxcyte announced positive trial results for its pneumonia vaccine. Separately, reports of a suspected plague outbreak in Russia also triggered sectorwide optimism.

## PCVX’s Trial Sets The Tone

Vaxcyte said earlier on Monday that its experimental pneumonia vaccine, VAX-31, met the main goals of a late-stage study in adults 50 and older.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

The shot is designed to cover 31 strains of the bacteria that cause pneumococcal disease, which can lead to pneumonia, meningitis and bloodstream infections. In the study, immune responses were at least comparable to Pfizer’s Prevnar 20 and Merck’s Capvaxive on the strains those vaccines already cover, and stronger on three strains unique to VAX-31. Vaxcyte said the safety profile was consistent across the age groups tested.

Vaxcyte [shares rose](https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/pcvx-stock-hits-fresh-52-week-high-on-late-stage-win-in-adult-pneumonia-vaccine-race-jefferies-says-it-hit-blue-sky-case/cZDq3huRBjF) 31% in regular trading and revived interest in vaccine makers.

## Why Novavax Drew A Bid

Novavax’s own story is about partnerships. In late August, the company said partners Sanofi and Takeda had won approval for an updated version of its protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, Nuvaxovid, in the United States, the European Union and Japan ahead of the 2026–2027 season. In the U.S., the shot is cleared for people 65 and older and for those 12 to 64 with a condition that raises the risk of severe illness.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Sanofi holds the commercial rights in most markets and is carrying the vaccine into the fall season in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany and Canada. Novavax no longer sells it itself. It collects royalties on partner sales and is still due a $75 million manufacturing technology-transfer payment, which it has said it expects in the fourth quarter.

## Plague Outbreak Concerns

Over the weekend, reports circulated that a Russian lab worker has died from a possible case of pneumonic plague while working at the Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia. The reports are unconfirmed.

According to a report from Axios, President Trump said on Monday that the U.S. will help Russia in case of a pneumonic plague outbreak. Axios also reported that the White House is monitoring the outbreak. Novavax, however, has no plague vaccine.

Federal energy officials announced a conditional $4.2 billion loan commitment Monday to modernize and boost power production across nuclear generation facilities in Pennsylvania and Ohio, targeting rising regional electricity costs and surging energy demand.

The funding,[extended](https://www.energy.gov/articles/energy-department-announces-42-billion-investment-boost-nuclear-power-and-help-lower) by the U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing to Texas-based utility operator Vistra (VST), aims to expand generation capacity across existing facilities without necessitating new power transmission infrastructure.

[VST stock](https://stocktwits.com/symbol/VST) jumped about 4% on Monday.

## **Expanding Output and Facility Lifespans**

The planned upgrades focus on Vistra’s Beaver Valley plant in Pennsylvania, along with the Davis-Besse and Perry facilities in Ohio. By executing thermodynamic and hardware uprates, the project will add 433 megawatts of power capacity while maintaining nearly 4 gigawatts of steady baseload electricity—enough to supply power to more than 3 million households.

Earlier in January this year, Meta Platforms (META) struck 20-year agreements to buy power from Vistra’s Perry and Davis-Besse plants in Ohio and Beaver Valley plant in Pennsylvania.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Beyond expanding immediate output, the modernization strategy will help extend operational life cycles at the three Midwestern plants by up to 20 years beyond their current licensing terms. The conditional loan arrangement also leaves open an option to fund future uprates at Vistra’s Comanche Peak facility in Texas.

## **Workforce and Regional Grid Impact**

Construction, engineering, and specialized maintenance during scheduled outage periods are projected to support about 3,000 temporary jobs while protecting thousands of permanent operational positions at the facilities.

By boosting generation within established facility footprints, the funding addresses growing power consumption across the 13-state PJM Interconnection grid, which serves major industrial and residential centers throughout the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest regions.

Advertisement|[Remove ads.](https://stocktwits.com/subscriptions)

Final disbursement of the $4.2 billion loan remains contingent on Vistra meeting mandatory environmental, legal, technical, and financial criteria required by federal regulators.

**Nvidia** ([NVDA](/quote/nasdaq/nvda/) +2.12%) is getting closer and closer to setting a new market cap record. It is currently a $5.6 trillion company, placing a $6 trillion market cap within reach by the end of this year. But where will it be by 2028?

Judging by Nvidia's current outlook and valuations, it will reach an unexpected level: I think it can easily breach the $10 trillion mark and go even higher. That makes the stock a no-brainer buy, as it indicates it will double in about two and a quarter years. So, how will it reach a $10 trillion market cap?

Easy: It just needs to hit projections.

![Nvidia's logo on a green background. ](https://g.foolcdn.com/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fg.foolcdn.com%2Feditorial%2Fimages%2F889969%2Fnvidia.png&w=3840&op=resize)

Image source: The Motley Fool.

## Nvidia is not an expensive stock

Somewhere along the way, Nvidia's stock developed a narrative that it was expensive. While I'll buy that argument from a trailing-earnings standpoint if you rewind to 2024, that's truly not the case right now. Nvidia trades at 29.5 times trailing earnings, which is about where you'd expect a [big tech stock](https://www.fool.com/investing/stock-market/market-sectors/information-technology/) to trade. The problem is, Nvidia is no ordinary big tech stock.

[NVDA PE Ratio](https://ycharts.com/companies/NVDA/pe_ratio) data by [YCharts](https://ycharts.com)

Nvidia more than doubled its revenue year over year in its most recent quarterly results, and it told investors it expects 70% revenue growth in the next fiscal year. Find another big tech stock that's expecting that kind of growth that isn't valued at this low a level. It's not possible.

Nvidia is actually quite cheap, and despite management telling investors that it's going to grow rapidly next year and several other firms backing that projection, there isn't really any of next year's growth priced into the stock.

[NVDA PE Ratio (Forward 1y)](https://ycharts.com/companies/NVDA/forward_pe_ratio_1y) data by [YCharts](https://ycharts.com)

Nvidia trades for nearly 15 times next year's earnings. So even if the stock rallies to 30 times earnings by the end of the year while meeting projections, it would double. That indicates Nvidia's stock will reach a valuation exceeding $10 trillion by the end of the next fiscal year, which ends in January 2028. So, I think it's pretty safe to say that Nvidia will reach a $10 trillion market cap by 2028, and with more growth expected in the artificial intelligence industry through 2030, it will reach even higher levels over the rest of 2028.

news.raw_content:
In this article

There's a simple reason the Nasdaq-100 Index closed at new records Friday: the world's biggest company notched its first record since May.

Nvidia, which accounts for 13% of the Nasdaq and 8% of the S&P 500 Index, added 1.3% Friday, ending seven weeks of sideways trading surrounding a high-stakes meeting between the President and corporate executives leading "Super Intelligence."

The rally puts the value of Jensen Huang's semiconductor business at just under $5.7 trillion, and based on the price of options trading at Nvidia, it will likely cross the $6 trillion threshold by the end of this month.  
It should be a comforting notion for equity bulls.   
Currently, there is about a 50% chance Nvidia will reach a $6 trillion valuation between now and the end of this month, and a 13% chance it happens this week, according to market-maker pricing of deltas on Nvidia options expiring this week and Oct. 30, which measure the sensitivity of options pricing relative to moves in the stock. The odds it happens between now and December 18 is about 67%.

They're also implying about a one-in-sixteenth chance Nvidia could hit $7 trillion by Nov. 20. Based on the current share count, Nvidia would need to touch $248 to cross the milestone.

"Nvidia's buyback announcement was a bright spot," Ben Emons, managing director at Highline Asset Management, wrote in a note to clients last week. "The buyback is not just a payout but a capital-allocation event that asserts confidence in long-run AI demand."

It's important to note when using deltas to gauge a range of possibilities that the same size move in the opposite direction is also just as likely. While that's largely the case for Nvidia, some many of the stock's call options are currently trading with a higher implied volatility than the equivalent puts, Barchart data show. Such "call skew" is a sign that traders have a bias is towards hedging for a rally.

Overview Our Company and Our Businesses NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. Since our original focus on PC graphics, we have expanded to several other large and important computationally intensive fields. Fueled by the sustained demand for exceptional 3D graphics and the scale of the gaming market, NVIDIA has leveraged its GPU architecture to create platforms for scientific computing, AI, data science, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and digital twin applications. NVIDIA is now a data center-scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries. Our two operating segments are “Compute & Networking” and “Graphics.” Refer to Note 13 of the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements in Part I, Item 1 of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for additional information. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, NVIDIA was incorporated in California in April 1993 and reincorporated in Delaware in April 1998. Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges Revenue growth in the second quarter and the first half of fiscal year 2027 was driven by data center products for accelerated computing and AI solutions. Blackwell continued to account for the majority of our system shipments. Our next-generation Data Center architecture, Vera Rubin, began production shipments in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027. We will be shipping both Blackwell and Rubin systems in the future and are currently experiencing certain supply constraints. Demand estimates for our products can be inaccurate and create volatility in our revenue or supply levels. To secure inventory and capacity to meet demand for the next several years, we have entered into significant commitments and may continue to enter into manufacturing and supply agreements for both current and future products, and we continue to expand our supplier base. The scale and size of our production needs and the complexity of producing our data center systems has caused and could in the future cause delays in production, challenges in managing supply and demand, revenue volatility, quality issues, increased inventory provisions, decreases in product yields, higher material 25 costs, and increased warranty costs. We have significantly increased our supply and capacity commitments from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026 to meet future demand. Refer to Note 10 of the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part 1, Item 1 of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q. Customers may postpone purchasing new architectures due to the lack of availability of data center infrastructure to deploy our products, constraints on capital to have sufficient funding to purchase our products, or may adopt new technologies more gradually than anticipated, affecting our revenue timing and supply chain expenses. The availability of land, power, shell, and capital is crucial to support the buildout of a full data center inclusive of NVIDIA AI infrastructure by our customers and partners, and any shortage of these or other necessary resources could impact our future revenue and financial performance. Expanding land, power, shell, and energy needs to meet demand is a complex, multi-year process that involves significant regulatory, technical, and construction challenges. In addition, access to capital can be particularly constrained for less-capitalized companies, which may face difficulties securing financing for large-scale infrastructure projects. We believe AI clouds and AI model makers have significant demand for training and inference compute and currently lack the ability to secure long-term infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity to secure the AI infrastructure necessary to grow. These limitations could delay customer and partner deployments or reduce the scale of accelerated computing and AI adoption and may impact the growth of our revenue. We have undertaken initiatives to address these challenges including securing and providing guarantees of land, power, shell, and capacity of select data center infrastructure that customers require to deploy our products. We expect to focus our data center infrastructure initiatives on exceptional sites and apply the same discipline to these initiatives as we do to our supply-chain management by securing critical inputs when we have visibility into customer demand and when doing so enables long-term productive capacity. We expect our large cloud service provider customers and investment grade enterprises to continue to secure land, power, and shell commitments independently. Our land, power, and shell commitments and guarantees may impact our financial results and are dependent on the performance of our customers and partners. In August 2026, we entered into guarantees with SB Energy Corp. to provide credit support on the land, power, and shell buildout at SB Energy’s PORTS Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, covering leases for approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load. The campus will exclusively host our compute under 20-year leases to OpenAI, subject to limited exceptions, with our obligation capped at $105 billion in the aggregate, subject to certain conditions including SB Energy, the lessor, satisfying applicable ready-for-service conditions. Each guarantee generally becomes effective upon commencement of the applicable lease, with corresponding guarantee amounts increasing as each of nine data centers is placed in service, which is expected to begin in fiscal year 2029. Our exposure declines as OpenAI fulfills its lease payments. Our guarantees are limited to defined portions of lease and power payments and not the full cost of the site or all of the tenant’s obligations. The guarantees terminate upon certain events, including OpenAI achieving a satisfactory credit rating or after each respective lease term has completed. We also hold an option, exercisable in our sole discretion, to provide additional credit support in phases for approximately 3.8 additional gigawatts as the site scales. Refer to Note 10 of the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements in Part 1, Item 1 of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q. We have made, and may continue to make, investments and commitments in our ecosystem to enhance our growth opportunities, cultivate our ecosystem, and strengthen our competitive position. These include equity investments of $99 billion and equity investment commitments of $25 billion as of July 26, 2026. In the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, we introduced a new business model with certain select AI cloud partners, to enable broader access to our data center infrastructure products to serve AI startups, model builders, enterprises, research organizations, and sovereign customers. We believe these AI cloud partners have strong customer demand and robust sales pipelines but are constrained by the large-scale infrastructure that is required to meet that demand. Through this model, we expect our AI cloud partners will be able to deploy incremental NVIDIA AI infrastructure, enabling them to serve a broader set of customers and address expanding demand for AI compute. Under these agreements, AI clouds procure our data center infrastructure products and we commit to cloud service agreements, which the AI clouds can unilaterally stop providing to us and sell to third-party customers at more advantageous rates. Our commitments, which are typically six years in duration, totaled $36 billion as of July 26, 2026, and decrease as capacity is used by third-party customers or by us for our research and development efforts. If certain criteria are met, we will participate in revenue share generated by the AI clouds from third-party customers, which may contribute to revenue in the future. If market conditions change, it may negatively impact our financial results. Refer to Note 10 of the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements in Part 1, Item 1 of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q. In August 2026, we entered into memorandums of understanding with several large capital providers to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize more than $500 billion of third-party capital over time to support the deployment of AI infrastructure. These and other preliminary arrangements may not lead to definitive agreements. These arrangements are designed for our ecosystem partners and customers to build and gain access to AI infrastructure with the corresponding funding structures independently underwritten and provided by the capital providers. At our option, we may provide limited residual-value support for a portion of specific projects, subject to disciplined risk management and project-by-project evaluation. Open-source foundation models are rapidly growing in popularity with developers worldwide. We believe the demand for open-source foundation models and applications promotes use of our products worldwide. If these models and 26 applications are primarily deployed on competitors’ platforms, they could reduce demand for our offerings. Any regulatory control or other restriction that limits our ability to provide products and services that support third-party applications and models could have a material impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition. The U.S. government, or USG, granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers, but such sales were restricted by the PRC government, and we have been unable to sell all the products for which we have licenses. During the first half of fiscal year 2027, we incurred a $0.4 billion charge associated with H200 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H200 products diminished. After incurring that charge, we have made a fraction of the allowed shipments under the USG’s H200 licensing program. Those shipments account for less than 1% of Data Center revenue in our most recent quarter. The licenses require that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200s shipped under the new licensing program are subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. We have been unable to pass along any of the tariff to our customers, and do not anticipate doing so in the event we are able to sell licensed products into the China market. Our global supply chain for networking products, including our Israel operations, with approximately 6,200 employees, supporting research and development, operations, and sales and marketing, has not been significantly impacted by the conflict in the Middle East. If the conflict escalates or extends, it could affect future product development, supply chain, and revenue, and create business uncertainty. Macroeconomic factors, including tariffs, inflation, interest rate changes, capital market volatility, global supply chain constraints, and global economic and geopolitical developments and conflicts, have direct and indirect impacts on our results of operations, particularly demand for our products. While difficult to isolate and quantify, these macroeconomic factors impact our supply chain and manufacturing costs, employee wages, costs for capital equipment, the value of our investments, revenue, and competitive position. Our product and solution pricing generally does not fluctuate with short-term changes in our costs. Within our supply chain, we continuously manage product availability and costs with our vendors.
